test_intent: Verifies that SendToAdminChatAsync processes all notification types without throwing by iterating seven notification types and checking SendMessageAsync was called exactly seven times.
reason: Current test only verifies SendMessageAsync call count (7 times) without confirming messages go to the correct destination chat or contain correct content. The behavior of routing different notification types through the dispatcher is a real bot contract worth preserving. Rewrite to verify each notification type is sent to the correct chat ID with expected message content.
